title: Crestline Fleet Account Tenure Points for Early-Pay Discounts
content:
Long-standing Crestline Fleet Account holders earn tenure points on the early-pay discount. Tenure points are added to the early-pay rate, the percent at which the early-pay discount is figured on an invoice that earns it.

| Account approved | Tenure points |
|---|---|
| 60 or more whole months before today | 0.25 |
| 36 to 59 whole months before today | 0.10 |
| more recently (fewer than 36 whole months) | none |

Tenure is read from the approval date on the fleet account and counted in whole months up to today.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Whole months since approval | Tenure points |
|---|---|
| 35 | none |
| 36 | 0.10 |
| 59 | 0.10 |
| 60 | 0.25 |

The points are percentage points of the early-pay rate. On a program whose early-pay discount percent is 0, the invoice earns no discount, whatever is added to the early-pay rate.
